verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is isolated Devbox sandboxes for AI agents, explicitly separate from any production environment, with network egress controls, secrets management, snapshots, and no shared state with production systems by design. Docs emphasize secure, isolated execution ('secure sandboxed execution environments'), egress network policy control, and secrets scoped to the sandbox, directly supporting safe testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: no explicit case study or independent hands-on account confirming production-data isolation in a real deployment, and no direct statement contrasting sandbox vs production data access.
